verdict.rationale: Collecting user feedback is a fair question for an error-monitoring product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a crash-report dialog, feedback widget, or any way to attach user-submitted feedback to a specific error event. SDK callbacks (before notify, appHangCallback) only add developer diagnostic context, which is a building block rather than user feedback collection.

support.subject: As a developer, I can collect user feedback — a crash-report dialog or feedback widget — attached to the exact error event the user hit
